label: Town of Pittsford
header:
# Town of Pittsford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Pittsford, Selectboard Minutes, March 4, 2026 (pittsfordvermont.com): the March 3, 2026 ballot results read into the minutes record that Moderator Robb Spensley 'received enough votes to continue' in the office

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Pittsford's five selectboard members: Daniel Adams, Tom Hooker, Alicia Malay (Chair), David Mills, and Mark Winslow

Town of Pittsford, Selectboard Minutes, March 4, 2026 (pittsfordvermont.com): Mark Winslow was elected to a three-year term with 262 votes (Erin Eugair 216, write-ins 3) and Dan Adams was re-elected to a two-year term with 445 votes at the March 3, 2026 election

Town of Pittsford, Town Meeting Warning 2026: floor Article 6 asked whether the voters would authorize the Selectboard to appoint the Town Clerk under 17 V.S.A. section 2651e, and ballot Article 9 elected a Town Clerk for a three-year term

Town of Pittsford, Selectboard Minutes, March 4, 2026 (pittsfordvermont.com): the ballot results read into the minutes give Dolores Gecha 456 votes for Town Clerk; the same minutes then record, after executive session, that the Selectboard appointed Dolores Gecha as Town Clerk effective 45 days from the Town Meeting election (April 17, 2026) for a term of three years. The voters having authorized appointment, she holds the office by appointment, and she is minted appointed; no separate election record is created for the office

Town of Pittsford, Town Meeting Warning 2026: floor Article 7 asked whether the voters would authorize the Selectboard to appoint the Town Treasurer under 17 V.S.A. section 2651f, and ballot Article 9 elected a Town Treasurer for a three-year term

Town of Pittsford, Selectboard Minutes, March 4, 2026 (pittsfordvermont.com): the ballot results read into the minutes give the Town Treasurer race 457 votes (the results line does not repeat the winner's name); the same minutes record that the Selectboard appointed Dolores Gecha as Town Treasurer, with the clerkship, effective 45 days from the Town Meeting election (April 17, 2026) for a term of three years. She is minted appointed

offices.title: Trustee of Public Funds
offices.org_name: Town of Pittsford Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: Town of Pittsford, Town Meeting Warning 2026: ballot Article 9 elects a Trustee of Public Funds for a three-year term; one such seat stands each year, so the board has three seats

Town of Pittsford, Selectboard Minutes, March 4, 2026 (pittsfordvermont.com): Dolores Gecha was elected Trustee of Public Funds with 450 votes. The other two seats' holders are published in no current official source, so they are created without memberships

sources.note: Town of Pittsford, Selectboard Minutes, March 4, 2026 (pittsfordvermont.com): the Selectboard's annual appointments motion of March 4, 2026 appoints the Town Manager, Ann Reed, as Collector of Delinquent Taxes. The office is filled by appointment in Pittsford
